title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan questions Cheran's silence as Chandayatha's parents falsely accuse Nila. His anger sparks tension within the family over Chandayatha's fabricated claim of an abortion.

title: Connect Link Pannu Win Pannu
description: Vijay TV's real-life couples dive into a night of hilarious games and clue-guessing. One star pair outpaces the competition in the visual round to lead the pack towards victory.

title: Neeya Naana
description: Gopinath hosts a lively debate on obedient versus independent children. As both sides clash over career choices and family rules, the top speakers receive special gift hampers.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Pandian confronts Senthil for questioning his opposition to Saravanan's wedding to Anjali. Sakthivel conceals Muthuvel's health issues and asks Raji to visit her father regularly.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Uma's father visits Vijaya's house with his daughter to seek a bride. Vijaya assumes Uma is Manoj's match, but the truth emerges when they discover the mix-up.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: Judges Chithra and Imman perform a splendid duet as the battle for the third finalist spot intensifies. Romantic duets, stunning acts keep the judges and the audience captivated.
